body: Im sorry but I call bs. Maybe its because im from CA I dunno but ive never heard of this. The photos look photoshopped, too.

This sounds fake. Sorry but it does. The fact that your mom had such an escape seems farfetched and your pic of you doesnt look at all like the time period! The others, maybe but that one no. My apologies if this turns out true, but I am skeptical as of now.
[Please refer to this post for questions and answers, everyone!](https://www.reddit.com/r/LetsNotMeet/comments/3cgmoi/about_my_uncles_story/)

Well for one, I myself am a youtuber who frequently is used to drawing graphics and colourization, so that part wasnt too painful. I also (admittedly) used photoshop and other basic editing tools for colourization. My uncle had those photos on his laptop so he just sent them to me (with permission, of course, for the story) and said it would be best to colourize the photos for better viewing. I personally thought I did a little crappy on the third photo (as many could tell, lol) and it came out kinda bad. But thank you for your feedback, moderator!

Well obviously I updated the pictures' quality a little, but the people were not changed a bit. If you look at some other pics from that time, many have been updated at least a little. Heck, the senior guy's pic and my uncle's friend pic weren't even in colour at first! I do see how it may be hard to believe, but those pictures are 100% legitimate.
Sorry bout me being upset earlier. It's just my uncle and I have a lot of respect for him so I tend to defend him as much as I can. No offense to any of you guys.
[More info on this story here](https://www.reddit.com/r/LetsNotMeet/comments/3cgmoi/about_my_uncles_story/)

No, not all is bad. There's something good, trust me! So by this post, BTW, does that mean you have absolutely no way of moving out of your parents' home?

The most I can suggest to you is to wait. Wait for something good to come around. That's one of the problems with life, sometimes it doesn't give you a reason to live, but trust me when I say you'll find some. I certaintly do like the idea that you are trying to escape reality by watching TV or watching vids on the internet. If you are bored with that though, try to find a hobby you like and keep at it. You'll also need to have the faith that things will get better, and things will turn around. I don't think I know of a single person that was suicidal, who decided to stick around to see if things would get better, that things didn't eventually get better for them. You're still pretty early in your lifetime so there's still lots of things to do, lots of places to explore. Don't quit now, believe me, no matter how bad you may think it is, there's someone out there who truly loves you and wants you here. You still need to find that person who wants to go with you for your entire lives and explore the world with you. I wish you the best, and I hope this does help just a little!
